subject: maths
question: A and B entered into a partnership with certain investments. At the end of 8 months, A withdrew and collected back his money. A and B received profit in the ratio 5 ∶ 9 at the end of the year. If B had invested Rs. 36,000, then how much (in Rs.) had A invested?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit Ratio = (InvestmentA × TimeA) : (InvestmentB × TimeB)

5 : 9 = (IA × 8) : (36,000 × 12)

IA = (5 ÷ 9) × (36,000 × 12 ÷ 8)

IA = 5 × 4,000 × 1.5 = 30,000

**∴ The correct answer is 30,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Investment of B = Rs. 36,000 | Time for A = 8 months | Time for B = 12 months | Profit Ratio A : B = 5 : 9

Formula Used: Profit = Investment × Time

⇒ ProfitA ÷ ProfitB = (InvA × TimeA) ÷ (InvB × TimeB)

⇒ 5 ÷ 9 = (IA × 8) ÷ (36,000 × 12)

⇒ 5 ÷ 9 = (8 × IA) ÷ 432,000

⇒ 8 × IA × 9 = 5 × 432,000

⇒ 72 × IA = 2,160,000

⇒ IA = 2,160,000 ÷ 72

⇒ IA = 30,000

**∴ The correct answer is 30,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Distribution Rule

In any partnership, the ratio of profits is directly proportional to the product of capital invested and the time duration: P₁ : P₂ = C₁T₁ : C₂T₂.

Capital Calculation

If profits and time periods are known, the ratio of investments is: C₁ : C₂ = (P₁/T₁) : (P₂/T₂).

Working vs Sleeping Partner

A working partner manages the business and may receive a salary or fixed percentage of profit before the remaining profit is divided based on the investment ratio.
